name: line-flex-message-renderer
description: React component to render LINE Flex Message JSON as a visual preview — pixel-accurate to the LINE app.
author: kanketsu-jp

scripts.build: tsup && tailwindcss -i src/wysiwyg/ui/styles.css -o dist/wysiwyg.css --minify && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/wysiwyg.css';const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const n=(s.match(/:root,:host/g)||[]).length;if(n===0){console.error('scope fix: no :root,:host found (output format changed?)');process.exit(1)}const out=s.replaceAll(':root,:host','.lfw-root,:host');if(out.includes(':root')){console.error('scope fix: :root still remains after replace');process.exit(1)}fs.writeFileSync(f,out);console.log('scope fix: replaced '+n+' occurrence(s)')"
scripts.build:wysiwyg-css: tailwindcss -i src/wysiwyg/ui/styles.css -o dist/wysiwyg.css --minify && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/wysiwyg.css';const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const n=(s.match(/:root,:host/g)||[]).length;if(n===0){console.error('scope fix: no :root,:host found (output format changed?)');process.exit(1)}const out=s.replaceAll(':root,:host','.lfw-root,:host');if(out.includes(':root')){console.error('scope fix: :root still remains after replace');process.exit(1)}fs.writeFileSync(f,out);console.log('scope fix: replaced '+n+' occurrence(s)')"
